title: How many CFD runs the cheap model buys
description: The capsule-aeroheating corpus (1.024 panel-method runs, 64 laminar Navier-Stokes ones on the same wall) as multi-fidelity learning curves, per capsule and per field: the cheap model, a surrogate from the design alone, a learned correction, and the correction with the cheap model as an input; and, for the 2.361-node field, a few modes of the relative residual whose amplitudes are learned from the design.
